title: IndicatorDesignation
description: A governed management designation applied to a PerformanceMetric (CR-MET-008 binding). The Metric identity is preserved across designations (EGV-004); one Metric may carry multiple designations (KPI Lagging, KRI Leading, etc.) for different management purposes.

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

associated_metric_ref.description: The PerformanceMetric id being designated (relationship dea:has-designation, inverse dea:designates).

management_purpose.description: Why the designation exists. For KPI: 'evaluating performance against objective X'. For KRI: 'monitoring risk exposure of risk Y'. For KCI: 'evaluating control effectiveness of control Z'.

associated_objective_ref.description: The StrategicObjective, Outcome, Risk, or Control this designation supports. KPI points to business objective; KRI points to risk-objective; KCI points to control objective. The user-supplied sections 6-8 requirement.

organizational_scope.description: Scope of application (enterprise, business_domain, business_unit, capability, process, product_or_service, system). Aligns with Metric.scope_classification (CR-MET-002). String or array of strings.

target_reference.description: Reference to a PerformanceTarget (CR-MET-006) applicable to this designation.

threshold_reference.description: Reference to a Threshold (CR-MET-006) applicable to this designation.

escalation_rules.description: Required management response (e.g., notification policy, runbook, escalation chain). String or array of strings/references.

measurement_orientation.description: CR-MET-008 binding (IndicatorDesignation.measurement_orientation controlled vocabulary; 3 values). Cross-cutting attribute: the same Metric may be designated as KPI Leading for one purpose and KPI Lagging for another.

effective_period.description: Reference to a TemporalInterval; CR-MET-006 binding (also applies to designation).
